subject: executor: revert #25730 to fix #28011 (#42488)
summary: Reverts the prior behavior that converted pessimistic LOCK records on unique index keys into MemBuffer PUTs in `PointGetExecutor` and `BatchPointGetExec`, and replaces the old lock-to-put test with a regression test for issue #28011 involving `REPLACE` after point/batch locking operations. No remaining Blocker/High issues found relative to the first parent; later history up to `upstream/master` does not reintroduce the reverted lock-to-put MemBuffer writes.
